extension.name: TDD Extension
extension.description: Drives spec-kit implementation with tests: a language-agnostic red-green-refactor loop with a per-feature test list, recorded red and green evidence, and mutation-checked test strength.
extension.author: d0whc3r

commands.name: speckit.tdd.setup
commands.description: Detect the repository's test stack and write .specify/memory/tdd-profile.md with the exact verified commands the loop needs (single test, full suite, coverage, mutation), plus the TDD principle to add to the project constitution

commands.name: speckit.tdd.plan
commands.description: Derive the feature's test list from spec.md and plan.md into specs/<feature>/tdd/test-list.md (outer acceptance behaviors, inner unit behaviors, each traced to an acceptance criterion) and make the test tasks in tasks.md mandatory and correctly ordered

commands.name: speckit.tdd.run
commands.description: Drive the red-green-refactor loop one behavior at a time from the test list: write one failing test, prove it fails for the right reason, make it pass with the smallest change, refactor while green, record the evidence in the feature's tdd/cycle-log.md, and tick the tasks.md tasks the completed behaviors cover

commands.name: speckit.tdd.verify
commands.description: Audit the feature's TDD discipline and test strength from cold context: test-first evidence in git history, red-phase evidence, test-smell rubric, mutation testing on the changed files, and acceptance-criteria coverage, then write specs/<feature>/tdd/verification.md with a verdict and remediation tasks

hooks.prompt: Derive the TDD test list and make the test tasks in tasks.md mandatory?
hooks.description: Generate specs/<feature>/tdd/test-list.md from spec.md and plan.md, then reorder tasks.md so every behavior has a failing test before its implementation

hooks.prompt: Drive the behavioral tasks through the red-green-refactor loop first?
hooks.description: Run the loop over every behavior on the feature's tdd/test-list.md, one failing test at a time with the red recorded, ticking the tasks each behavior completes so /speckit.implement then covers only the work that is not a behavior change

hooks.prompt: Audit TDD discipline and test strength for this feature?
hooks.description: Write specs/<feature>/tdd/verification.md: test-first evidence, test-smell rubric, mutation results, and acceptance-criteria coverage
